title: Run length bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Turing machine with associated quantities $L(M)$, and let $n,T$ be nonnegative integers and $z$ a finite Boolean word. Define the run bound as the prefix bound plus $(T+1)(B+7T+10)+L(M)+2$, where $B$ is the layer bound for $M,n,z,T$.
caveat: The supplied statement omits the meanings of L(M) and the layer bound, which is itself defined using other omitted machine-associated quantities.
